item.description:
KeyHop’s first release makes everyday app switching immediate and predictable.
- Double-tap your chosen modifier, then press a home-row key to jump directly to an assigned app. - Assign up to ten apps and keep their positions consistent across supported keyboard layouts. - Follow a guided first-run experience with clearer Accessibility permission recovery. - Use the new app icon and pixel-sharp menu bar symbol, with matching balanced spacing. - Pause KeyHop, resume it, or launch it automatically when you sign in.
